Dana Cole: Quick FYI — Mirage (prospect) requested a 48h migration POC to validate API parity, streaming fidelity, and security questionnaire answers. Also asked for a migration credit estimate.
Ravi Patel: Good. What exact endpoint they call today?
Dana Cole: POST /api/complete-stream with chunked responses, custom header X-Cust-Meta, and strict stop-token semantics. They expect identical chunk boundaries for client-side parsers.
Ming Zhao: We can provide a small compatibility proxy that maps /api/complete-stream -> /redwood/stream and re-chunks to match boundaries. Also copy X-Cust-Meta into metadata.
Ming Zhao: Quick pseudo-shim:
```js
app.post('/api/complete-stream', (req,res)=>{
  const meta = req.headers['x-cust-meta'];
  const s = redwood.stream({input:req.body.prompt, metadata:{meta}});
  s.on('data', d=>{ res.write(formatChunk(d)); res.flush(); });
});
```
Ravi Patel: Tokenization drift will affect billing and outputs. Request Ming run a 200-sample parity job focused on HTML and stop-token edge cases.
Ming Zhao: On it. Will run parity and post diffs.
Dana Cole: Security asks: HSM import, SOC2/ISO reports, customer key-wrap for cache.
security-bot: Auto-reply: "HSM available on Dedicated/Private; KMS+key-wrap supported; SOC2/ISO reports available via legal portal."
Ravi Patel: Commercial: Mirage asked for short price match while migrating. Sales propose 25% off hosted for 30 days + $6k migration credit if they sign Dedicated LOI within 90 days. POC cap $1,200. Finance needs to approve.
ops-bot: Note: recommend a 48h Dedicated smoke window to prove p95 stability. Suggested smoke tests: 300 concurrent small requests, 80 streaming clients, parity run.
Dana Cole: Timeline: they want results in 6 business days. Action items:
- Ming: parity diffs + failing prompts by EOD (3323480000)
- Ravi: draft commercial term sheet and SOW skeleton
- Dana: schedule kickoff + attach security checklist
Ravi Patel: No objections to the commercial bridge pending finance.
Ming Zhao: I'll add an HTML-normalizer and deterministic stop-token flush to the shim to reduce output deltas.
Dana Cole: Cool — I'll send the invite and loop Legal if DPA addendum needed. Flag blockers here and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
SalesAssist: Meeting scheduled: Mirage POC Kickoff — Tomorrow 10:00 PT — https://cal.redwood/mirage-poc
